headline: The Tax Agency collects more than 100,000 million in VAT for the first time, half of it in Madrid
summary: Spain's Tax Agency collected more than 100,000 million euros in VAT for the first time, with half from Madrid. The elimination of inflation-related bonuses drove revenue up by 9.2%.
why: Tax receipts indicate fiscal capacity and consumer spending, which affect Spain's public finances and sovereign bond supply.
